title: Design System: Melbourne Housing Model Studio

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Short hover and focus transitions for controls.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.purpose: Softly transition page and text colors when switching themes.

motion.name: result-entry
motion.purpose: Brief upward reveal when a prediction result appears.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The green action that requests a property estimate.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent, #397354); font: 590 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, background 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #2d6348); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ab99a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Train Action
components.description: A full-width pale action within the dark training card.
components.css: .ds-btn-train { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: #263b2d; background: #dcebdd; font: 590 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, background 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-train:hover { background: #c9dfce; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-train:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bc7a5; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-train:disabled { opacity: .48; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Property Field
components.description: A labeled numeric field or select for property details.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink, #202820); font: 550 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field small { margin-left: 4px; color: var(--muted, #6d776e); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 41px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e8e1); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--ink, #202820); background: var(--surface-soft, #f8f9f6); font: 450 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8ab99a; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--accent, #397354); }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: A white bordered surface for property inputs and the learning curve.
components.html:
Property details

Describe a home to estimate its market value.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 25px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e8e1); border-radius: 13px; color: var(--ink, #202820); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-card strong { font: 620 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-card p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #6d776e); font: 400 12px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Training Card
components.description: A dark green grouped surface for optimizer and training choices.
components.html:
Train the model

Choose how the model measures error and updates its weights.
components.css: .ds-training { padding: 25px; border: 1px solid #273d30; border-radius: 13px; color: #edf4ef; background: #273d30; } .ds-training strong { color: #f0f5f1; font: 620 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-training p { margin: 8px 0 18px; color: #bdcbbf; font: 400 11px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-training button { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: #263b2d; background: #dcebdd; font: 590 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-training button:hover { background: #c9dfce; } .ds-training button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bc7a5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Learning Curve Card
components.description: A quiet chart surface with sparse gridlines and an accent loss curve.
components.html: Learning curve
components.css: .ds-chart { padding: 21px 23px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e8e1); border-radius: 13px; color: var(--ink, #202820); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-chart strong { font: 620 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 14px; } .ds-grid { fill: none; stroke: var(--line, #e4e8e1); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--chart, #4b8863); stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-end { fill: var(--surface, #fff); stroke: var(--chart, #4b8863); stroke-width: 2.5; }

narrative.overview: The interface treats model training as hands-on work: property inputs and training controls sit together, followed by a learning curve that shows what the selected loss did over time. The visual tone is restrained and practical, with a muted green accent connecting the housing context to the model's training state. The light theme is the default; a dark theme keeps the same hierarchy with deeper green surfaces. The page favors clear labels, compact controls, and explanatory notes over decorative imagery. Visual emphasis follows the user's sequence: describe a home, train the model, read the training curve, then request an estimate. This is an implementation-derived direction, not a separately confirmed brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Calm green accents over soft neutral surfaces.
Clear separation between property entry and training controls.
Training progress is shown as data, with its scope explained in plain language.

rules.name: The Green Means Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve the strongest green for actions, selected states, and the chart; keep explanatory text neutral.

dos: Do keep the training-to-prediction sequence visible in the page hierarchy.
Do pair every metric or chart with a clear label and explain that the current curve measures training data.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and readable contrast in both themes.
Do let cards and form fields stack cleanly on small screens.
donts: Don't style training loss as a measure of accuracy on unseen homes.
Don't introduce bright unrelated accent colors or decorative imagery that competes with the data.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate API status, selected controls, or loss direction.
Don't add shadows or oversized rounded controls; the current hierarchy depends on tonal surfaces and quiet borders.
